```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5.5, dpi = 120)
source("../R/_load.R")
```

Model 1 is a design-based logistic regression (`survey::svyglm`, quasibinomial), with confidence intervals from the t distribution on the design degrees of freedom.

```{r fit}
df <- readRDS(file.path(cfg$paths$out, "data", "analysis_data.rds"))
fm <- model_formula(cfg); m1 <- fit_survey_logit(df, fm)
or1 <- label_terms(tidy_or(m1$fit, m1$design, cfg$analysis$conf_level), cfg$analysis$covariates)
or1 <- or1[!is.na(or1$variable), ]; save_table(or1, "03_model1_adjusted_or", cfg)
knitr::kable(or1[, c("variable", "category", "or", "ci_low", "ci_high", "p_value")], digits = 3)
```

## Forest plot

```{r forest, fig.height = 8}
p <- forest_plot(or1, "Model 1: adjusted odds ratios of adequate ANC"); save_fig(p, "03_forest_model1", cfg, 8, 8); p
```

## Fit, discrimination and collinearity

```{r diagnostics}
y <- m1$data$adequate_anc; pr <- as.numeric(predict(m1$fit, type = "response")); w <- m1$data$wt
hl <- hosmer_lemeshow(y, pr, w); auc <- model_auc(y, pr)
fit_stats <- data.frame(n = nrow(m1$data), nagelkerke_r2 = nagelkerke_r2(fm, m1$data), hl_chisq = hl$chisq, hl_p = hl$p_value, auc = auc$auc)
save_table(fit_stats, "03_fit_statistics", cfg); knitr::kable(fit_stats, digits = 3)
vif <- vif_table(fm, m1$data); save_table(vif, "03_vif", cfg); knitr::kable(vif, digits = 2)
```

The Hosmer and Lemeshow test here forms ten groups of equal total weight. SPSS forms its groups differently, so the p value can differ slightly between the two programs; the conclusion on calibration should not.

```{r calib}
p <- calibration_plot(y, pr, w); save_fig(p, "03_calibration", cfg, 5, 5); p
```

## Standardised predicted probabilities

```{r margins}
sp <- bind_rows(lapply(c("education", "wealth", "residence", "parity"), function(v) standardised_predictions(m1$fit, m1$data, v)))
save_table(sp, "03_standardised_predictions", cfg); knitr::kable(sp, digits = 1)
```

## Optimal ANC (eight or more visits) and early booking

```{r secondary}
m_opt <- fit_survey_logit(df, model_formula(cfg, "optimal_anc"))
or_opt <- label_terms(tidy_or(m_opt$fit, m_opt$design), cfg$analysis$covariates); or_opt <- or_opt[!is.na(or_opt$variable), ]
save_table(or_opt, "03_optimal_anc_or", cfg); knitr::kable(or_opt[, c("variable", "category", "or", "ci_low", "ci_high", "p_value")], digits = 3)
dt <- df[df$in_timing_sample, ]
m_tim <- fit_survey_logit(dt, model_formula(cfg, "adequate_anc", extra = "early_booking"), subset_col = "in_timing_sample")
or_t <- tidy_or(m_tim$fit, m_tim$design); save_table(or_t, "03_timing_model_or", cfg)
knitr::kable(or_t[grepl("early", or_t$term), ], digits = 3)
```
